title: Give planner and critic read-only git history and budgets printout
summary: Give the planner and critic a read-only snapshot with a git history (visible files only, throwaway repo) and a grant allowing only git log/show/diff/status and the budgets test command, no writes. Tell them in the planner and critic briefs, and add tests for the grants, the briefs, and git log in a fixture snapshot.

defaults_applied.how: Tests added for grants, briefs, and snapshot git log; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Criteria run git log in a fixture snapshot and check grant contents rather than only wiring.
The read-only limit is enforced by the grant's command allowlist, checked by a test.
Decision record and changelog written for outside readers.
Hidden paths stay hidden in the history snapshot.
Criteria check planners can read history, the outcome behind the work.
One focused change across the five named files.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: planner and critic agents (audience: Athena's planning loop and the maintainers judging it) get a history-bearing read-only git snapshot and the budgets printout command.
The planner is currently given Read/Grep/Glob only, no commands, over SnapshotRepo::None (run.rs ~635-676, ~815); the critic uses a similar snapshot.
History in the snapshot must obey the same hiding rules as today (no records/, no private paths), so it is built as a fresh throwaway repo with the visible history, not by sharing the user's .git.
No athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow change is needed since grants are in code.
Budgets printout command is allowed as a single exact command; it needs a built workspace, which the verifier already has.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner and critic grants in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs (shared helper) list Read, Grep, Glob plus Bash commands limited to read-only git (log, show, diff, status) and the exact budgets test command `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture`; writes stays false and no git write verb (commit, add, reset, checkout, push, config, etc.) is allowed.

A unit test asserts the planner and critic grants' command set equals exactly that allowlist and rejects write commands (git commit, git add, git checkout, cargo build, rm). Run: cargo test -p athena-core planner_grant (and the full cargo test -p athena-core).
A planning brief test shows planner_brief and critic_brief text names git log, git show, git diff and the budgets command as available read-only. Run: cargo test -p athena-context briefs.

A test in athena-git creates a planning snapshot (new SnapshotRepo variant with history) of a fixture repository and runs `git log` inside it, getting the fixture's commits; it also shows records/ and private paths are still absent from that history. Run: cargo test -p athena-git snapshot.
The history snapshot shares no objects, refs, config or hooks with the user's repository, and the planner/critic snapshot stays write-locked.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry and docs/decisions.md records the decision (alternatives: plain copy, shared repo; why read-only history helps, citing job 20261024-115923-02gf).
cargo test and cargo clippy --all-targets pass and cargo fmt --check is clean.

out_of_scope: Changing the reader's, producer's or verifier's grants
Allowing any git write command or other programs in planner/critic grants
Fixing the land --pr issue from job 20261024-115923-02gf
Exposing records/ or private files through the history snapshot
departures: Larger than typical: a new snapshot mode with history, grants for two roles, and tests across three crates.
urgent_reason: Planning stops and post-plan rejections (such as the one that broke land on every pull request in job 20261024-115923-02gf) came from facts only history shows, so this cuts wasted retries and planning stops.
